name: Cinematic / Landscape
displayName: 电影地貌 · 山谷醒来
description: 六层原创山脊、侧光薄雾、侵蚀纹理、松枝前景与溪流反光；用镜头穿行讲述十二秒山间光影。

canvas.adaptation: Reference composition; reflow freely for 9:16 or 1:1. Not an automatic aspect converter.

audio.note: Silent concept preview. Narration, character, voice, language and speaking rate remain user-controlled.

dependencies.fonts: Operating-system Arial/Georgia/monospace; none bundled or fetched. Font metrics can vary across systems.

variants.name: 山谷初光
variants.recipe: Warm dawn atmosphere, six moving terrain layers, illuminated stream and drifting airborne motes. Default variant.

variants.name: 月落山谷
variants.recipe: Cool nocturnal palette, moon crater marks, a deterministic star field, faint haze and different short Chinese copy.

usage.remix: Borrow camera(), profile(), ridge(), pine(), river() or atmosphere() independently. SVG ridge-layers.svg exposes named far/middle/near paths for vector-only remixes; pine-silhouette.svg is the actual moving foreground in this scene. Recompose freely instead of treating this as a fixed template.
usage.avoid: Fictional illustrative terrain, not a real destination or geographical reconstruction. Do not imply a measured sunrise, species, elevation or travel route. No narration, person, voice or speaking rate is set or changed.
usage.motion: 0–2s: foreground opens and title arrives. 2–6s: camera advances through six depth layers; sun rises and creek catches light. 6–8s: a quiet scenic interlude. 8–12s: final phrase settles over the illuminated valley. Every frame is a pure function of time.
usage.portrait: Preview uses the shared letterbox player at all viewport sizes. For a native 9:16 production, move the sun to the upper third, narrow the world camera and reflow the title; this pack does not claim automatic portrait recomposition.
usage.captions: Reserve lower-center for actual subtitles. The small lower-left fictional-scene disclaimer is not a subtitle. Copy is deliberately minimal; replace it with approved user copy.

provenance.creator: Short Video theme-pack contributors
provenance.scope: All HTML, CSS, Canvas2D math, SVG assets and poster artwork authored originally for this repository. Procedural terrain is fictional. No third-party source, images or generated photographs used.
